body.message:
If you prefer to proceed with a month-to-month booking, that is also possible.

However, please note that we will not be able to guarantee the apartment availability for future extensions, as the unit will remain available on our online platforms. The rates may also change depending on the market situation at the time of extension.

Alternatively, if you confirm a 3-month or 6-month booking under the above-mentioned terms, we will be able to guarantee the agreed rates and block the apartment exclusively for your stay. No changes will be made during the confirmed booking period.

Thank you.
